# DORMIED

> Golf's brand desk. Independent monthly rankings of 215 golf brands across 10 global markets, with editorial analysis of what is moving the game.

## About

DORMIED publishes the DORMIED Index, a monthly ranking of golf brands by real search demand across the US, UK, Japan, South Korea, Canada, Australia, China, Germany, France, and Sweden. A brand's DI Score is its search volume relative to the top brand in a given period (100 = most searched). Rankings update monthly.

We cover every major segment of golf: equipment, apparel, footwear, accessories, tech and training aids, balls, shafts and grips, and lifestyle brands. All editorial content is independent. No brand pays for placement or improved ranking position.

Founded: 2024. Contact: dormiedgolf@gmail.com. Publisher: DORMIED Golf.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://dormied.com/): Monthly match-ups, top movers, brand scorecard, latest DORMIED news
- [Rankings (DORMIED Index)](https://dormied.com/rankings/): Full 215-brand index table, sortable by 10 markets, updated monthly
- [The Scorecard](https://dormied.com/scorecard/): Monthly editorial breakdown of who moved, who faded, and why it matters
- [Brand Directory](https://dormied.com/brands/): Browse all 215 brands by category with DI scores and trend data
- [News Feed](https://dormied.com/news/): Original articles from golf's brand desk, tagged by brand, updated daily
- [WITB Player Directory](https://dormied.com/witb/players/): What tour pros play, tracked weekly across every club category
- [About](https://dormied.com/about/): Editorial mission, methodology, and team
- [Contact](https://dormied.com/contact/): Get in touch with DORMIED
- [Privacy Policy](https://dormied.com/privacy/): How DORMIED handles data
- [Terms](https://dormied.com/terms/): Terms of use
- [Full URL index](https://dormied.com/llms-full.txt): Every indexable page with its title
- [Sitemap](https://dormied.com/sitemap.xml): Full list of indexed URLs

## Brand Pages

Each of the 215 brands has a dedicated page at https://dormied.com/brands/[slug]/ with:

- Current global rank and DI Score
- Month-over-month change, 3-month trend, 12-month trend
- Monthly trend chart (12 or more months of data)
- Rankings across all 10 markets (US, UK, Japan, Korea, Canada, Australia, China, Germany, France, Sweden)
- A frequently-asked-questions block covering ownership, origin and category
- Latest DORMIED news articles covering that brand

## WITB: What Tour Pros Play

Every tracked player has a page at https://dormied.com/witb/players/[slug]/ listing the exact
driver, fairway woods, irons, wedges, putter, grips and ball in the current bag,
with the snapshot date and the full bag history. 195 players are tracked.

## Data Methodology

The DORMIED Index uses Google Trends search interest data as a proxy for brand relevance and consumer attention. Data is normalised so the top brand in each period scores 100. Rankings are updated monthly, typically in the first week of the following month.

Markets tracked: United States, United Kingdom, Japan, South Korea, Canada, Australia, China, Germany, France, Sweden.

## News Coverage

DORMIED publishes original editorial articles covering golf brand moves: equipment launches, apparel collections, athlete signings, retail shifts, marketing campaigns, and search-trend analysis. Each article is tagged to its primary brand and relevant secondary brands. Articles are available at the [News Feed](https://dormied.com/news/) and on individual brand pages.

## Social and Newsletter

- [X / Twitter](https://x.com/DORMIED_GOLF): Daily brand desk updates
- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/dormiedgolf): Visual brand coverage

## Content Policy

DORMIED is independent editorial content. All brand names and logos are property of their respective owners. Rankings reflect search data, not editorial opinion or commercial relationships. No brand pays for coverage or ranking position.
